skills.name: code-review-and-quality
skills.description: Review a proposed or completed change when the user explicitly requests code review. Evaluate correctness, maintainability, tests, security, compatibility, and evidence; do not edit unless fixes are separately requested.

skills.name: code-simplification
skills.description: Simplify existing code when the user explicitly requests a behavior-preserving clarity refactor. Reduce unnecessary complexity and duplication while preserving public contracts, errors, side effects, compatibility, and verified behavior.

skills.name: context-engineering
skills.description: Improve agent instructions, skill routing, task context, or handoffs when the user explicitly requests context optimization, stale-guidance repair, or session recovery. Keep durable guidance aligned with current repository evidence.

skills.name: context-scouting
skills.description: Delegate useful multi-step context discovery to bounded, read-only native scouts when explicitly invoked for the current task. Verify concise findings and use minimal direct lookup when delegation is unavailable.

skills.name: design-planning
skills.description: Prepare manifest-scoped UI design after an implementation plan, on explicit request. Use separately installed Penpot skills, save validated design contracts and snapshots, and update affected handoffs; do not implement.

skills.name: documentation-and-adrs
skills.description: Write or revise technical documentation or an architecture decision record when the user explicitly requests it. Ground claims in repository evidence, distinguish current from proposed behavior, and record settled trade-offs.

skills.name: doubt-driven-development
skills.description: Adversarially challenge a named high-risk product or technical decision with a fresh host-native reviewer when explicitly requested. Reconcile evidence, assumptions, failure modes, reversibility, and safe experiments.

skills.name: idea-refine
skills.description: Refine an idea explicitly in standalone mode or save a durable product Idea through workflow MCP. Compare evidence, alternatives, risks, and unresolved decisions; stop before Product Definition.

skills.name: incremental-implementation
skills.description: Implement exactly one authorized task packet per explicit invocation using test-first RED/GREEN/PROVE, verify it, update checklist and handoff, then stop.

skills.name: interview-me
skills.description: Run a structured requirements interview when the user explicitly asks to be interviewed, grilled, or guided through unresolved decisions. Use host-native questions, checkpoint explicit answers, and stop before downstream work.

skills.name: performance-optimization
skills.description: Diagnose or improve a measured latency, throughput, memory, startup, size, cost, or CI problem when the user explicitly requests optimization or provides regression evidence. Preserve correctness and do not optimize from guesswork.

skills.name: planning-and-task-breakdown
skills.description: Create adaptive-depth implementation plans from Approved specifications and confirmed scope when explicitly requested. Produce profile contracts, architecture, test-first tasks, and documentation; do not implement.

skills.name: product-definition
skills.description: Create or revise a PRD from a ready product Idea through workflow MCP. Confirm depth and profiles, capture product meaning and use cases, require review evidence, then stop before Technical Design.

skills.name: product-roadmap
skills.description: Create or revise a staged product roadmap from exact ready PRD and Technical Design pins. Keep distant stages coarse, define independent tasks without creating specifications, review, then stop.

skills.name: security-and-hardening
skills.description: Audit or harden a concrete trust boundary when the user explicitly requests security work or identifies a defect. Cover inputs, privileges, secrets, dependencies, filesystem/process boundaries, failure behavior, and verification.

skills.name: spec-driven-development
skills.description: Define or revise an adaptive-depth implementation-ready specification when explicitly requested. Confirm scope and profiles, persist decisions and manifest, mark the complete specification Approved, and stop before planning.

skills.name: technical-design
skills.description: Create or revise shared Technical Design from an exact ready PRD pin. Capture boundaries, evidence-grounded technology choices and policies, require review evidence, then stop before Product Roadmap.
